claim: Patchline ships a longitudinal impact-retrospective tying every major decision to a measured, published outcome. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the measured claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make longitudinal-impact-retrospective-gate`.
